scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
恭喜。
向战士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
Do you want to
sing a song with me?
Sha la la la la~
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
想和我一起唱首歌吗？
Sha la la la la~

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
The dreary world
of mortals is in need
of more cheerful song.
Will you bring it to them
and turn the tide in the
battle against evil?
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
沉闷的人间，需要更多欢快的歌声。
你愿意把歌声带给世人，扭转对抗邪恶的战局吗？

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
Will you do this
for Midgard...
As a Minstrel?
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
你愿意成为宫廷乐师，为米德加尔特献出这份力量吗？

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
准备好了，随时回来吧。
向战士们致敬！

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
你还有可以学习的技能。
请用完剩余的技能点，再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
Congratulations!
As a Minstrel, your
your songs will bring
hope to your allies, and
desperation to your foes.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
恭喜！
身为宫廷乐师，你的歌声将为盟友带来希望，让敌人陷入绝望。

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
欢迎来到荣耀之厅——英灵殿。

scripts.text:
[Minstrel]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[宫廷乐师]
在这里安心休息吧。
向战士们致敬！
